anchors.get_started: blue 'Get Started' button, centred below the airdrop headline on the landing page
anchors.email_field: single email input under an 'Email address' label on the registration form
anchors.submit_register: primary button (Continue/Submit) below the email field
anchors.name_field: text input under a 'Display name' label on the profile form
anchors.connect_x: button labelled 'Connect X (Twitter)' in the social section of the profile form
anchors.follow_quest: 'Follow @loqua on X' button, first quest card on the quest board
anchors.discord_quest: 'Join official Discord' button, second quest card, near the bottom of the quest board — scroll required
anchors.claim_link: appears below the quest board once both quests are completed
anchors.claim_button: green 'Claim Points' button on the claim page
anchors.success_banner: green confirmation line stating points were credited

notes: anchors are visual descriptions for re-matching on fresh screenshots — never selectors, never stale coordinates
